description: MJN infers the central median of three pairwise-distance-2 haplotypes
derivation: Hand-traced against MedJoinNet::computeMJN (epsilon=0). Sequences AAT, ATA, TAA are pairwise distance 2 with no pattern-equivalent columns (weights all 1). Iteration 1: the relaxed MSN adds all three distance-2 edges; the threshold graph (distance < 2) has no merges, so all are feasible links. Pass 1 finds the quasi-median of the triplet: per position the majority character gives AAA, cost d(AAT,AAA)+d(ATA,AAA)+d(TAA,AAA)=3 = minCost. Pass 2 adds AAA (cost <= minCost + 0). Iteration 2: distances sample-median are 1; the MSN connects as a star at level 1 (all feasible, threshold graph empty below 1), the direct distance-2 edges fall beyond maxValue=1. No new medians (u=AAA triplets regenerate AAA). Final phase keeps the star. Ids by sorted sequence: AAT->H1, ATA->H2, TAA->H3; the median is Median_0.
